# Termination, insolvency and bankruptcy {#sec-blp-termination}

> *Assessment objective 6: the termination of a solvent business, corporate insolvency and personal
> bankruptcy.*

::: {.callout-note title="Not yet written"}
Outline below.
:::

## Planned contents

**Solvent termination** — members' voluntary liquidation and the declaration of solvency; striking
off under s.1003 CA 2006 and when it is not available; dissolution of a partnership under ss.32–35
PA 1890 and the distribution of assets under s.44.

**Corporate insolvency: the tests** — the cash flow and balance sheet tests under s.123 Insolvency
Act 1986, and the statutory demand.

**The procedures** — administration and the moratorium; company voluntary arrangements; creditors'
voluntary liquidation; compulsory liquidation. What each is *for* is the discriminator, not the
mechanics.

**Asset recovery** — transactions at an undervalue (s.238); preferences (s.239) and the requirement
of a desire to prefer; extortionate credit transactions; avoidance of floating charges (s.245);
transactions defrauding creditors (s.423).

**Personal liability of directors** — wrongful trading (s.214) and the defence of taking every step
to minimise loss; fraudulent trading (s.213); misfeasance.

**Order of priority** — fixed charge holders, expenses of the liquidation, preferential creditors,
the prescribed part, floating charge holders, unsecured creditors, shareholders. This ranking is
examined directly and repays memorising.

**Personal bankruptcy** — the petition and the order; the trustee in bankruptcy; the bankrupt's
estate and excluded property; discharge; individual voluntary arrangements.

**Conduct** — a solicitor's position on discovering that a client company is trading while insolvent.
